title: Weekly stock template
intro: Set how much of each product you usually bring on a weekday, and at what price. Apply the template on a market morning to refill today's stock in one tap.

table.caption: Weekly stock template, one row per product and one column per weekday

template.note: Leave a day's quantity blank to skip it. A blank price keeps the product's current price when applied.

empty.title: Add a product first
empty.text: A weekly template needs at least one product to apply it to.

apply.title: Apply the template to a day
apply.text: Every product with a template for that weekday gets its stock and price refilled, and turns available again even if it was sold out.
apply.noneText: No template is set for that weekday yet.
